annotation: author pathologist labels; no marker inference
patient_identity: author naming A-H; one labeled section each, G2 for G
QC: author processed count matrix and selected tissue spots; require total>0; no imputation
statistics: two-sided exact patient sign test; >=3 evaluable patients for inferential reporting; nominal P, no FDR
sensitivities: within-patient OLS log normalized expression ~ invasive indicator + log1p(total counts)
not_claimed: normal epithelial validation from breast glands label alone
